# Spinne Software

> Hard technology, simple software. An Italian company building its own products: independent, built to be inherited, honest about what they do.

Spinne Software makes its own software instead of taking contracts. It is one engineer in Rome, and the order of the work is deliberate: build the machinery once, then build the products that stand on it. The ambition is stated plainly — products that hold their own against the best in their category, built by a company small enough to finish them.

## Pages

- [Spinne Software](https://spinnesoftware.com/): An Italian company that builds its own technology and makes it simple to use. What Spinne Software values, how it decides, and the first product: Sparkle.
- [A video editor with an engine under it](https://spinnesoftware.com/sparkle/): Sparkle is a desktop video editor: GPU rendering shared by preview and export, AI on your own machine, hardware encoding. In private preview.
- [Where the editor ends and the model begins](https://spinnesoftware.com/how-we-build/): How Sparkle is built: one document, one set of operations on it, and an assistant that is another caller rather than another program.
- [A technology company that ships](https://spinnesoftware.com/about/): Why Spinne Software builds its own products rather than taking contracts, how the work is decided, and the diligence answers — including the ones that are no.
- [Privacy — Spinne Software](https://spinnesoftware.com/privacy/): How spinnesoftware.com handles personal data. No cookies, no analytics, no third-party services, nothing sold or shared.
- [Transcribing video without uploading it](https://spinnesoftware.com/answers/transcribe-video-without-uploading/): Whisper runs on your machine. Which Sparkle settings keep the audio there, which one sends it to a cloud engine, and the eight-minute threshold that decides.
